title: TailProp: content-adaptive light- and heavy-tailed propagation for vision
abstract: arXiv:2609.11081v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Science-inspired vision models show that explicit propagation dynamics can provide structured and interpretable alternatives to conventional token mixing. Existing formulations, however, typically construct and adapt visual propagation within a particular dynamical family, while visual representations can require substantially different spatial interactions across samples, channels, and network stages. We explore cross-regime adaptive propagation and introduce TailProp, a hierarchical vision backbone built upon the Tail Propagation Operator (TPO). TPO uses Gaussian and Cauchy stable-process propagators as complementary bases with rapidly decaying and heavy-tailed spatial influence, and predicts a content-conditioned channel-wise coefficient to adaptively combine them. Because this coefficient is spatially shared, the two responses are fused directly in the DCT domain with a single DCT/IDCT pair, yielding $O(N^{1.5})$ spatial mixing for

translated_title: TailProp：面向视觉的内容自适应轻尾与重尾传播
translated_abstract: 受科学启发的视觉模型表明，显式的传播动力学可以为传统的token混合提供结构化且可解释的替代方案。然而，现有方法通常在特定的动力学族内构建和调整视觉传播，而视觉表征可能需要在样本、通道和网络层级之间具有显著不同的空间交互。我们探索跨动力学域的自适应传播，并提出TailProp，一个建立在尾传播算子（TPO）之上的分层视觉主干网络。TPO使用高斯和柯西稳定过程传播器作为互补基，分别提供快速衰减和重尾的空间影响，并预测内容条件的通道级系数来自适应地组合二者。由于该系数在空间上是共享的，两个响应可直接在DCT域中融合，仅需一对DCT/IDCT变换，从而实现O(N^1.5)的空间混合复杂度。
tldr: 提出TailProp分层视觉主干网络，其尾传播算子（TPO）以高斯（轻尾）和柯西（重尾）稳定过程传播器为互补基，通过内容自适应的通道级系数进行组合，并借助DCT域融合以O(N^1.5)复杂度实现跨样本、通道和层级多样空间交互需求的高效建模。
